mapper.select: SELECT ps.PAYSLIP_ID, ps.EMP_ID, CONCAT(e.FIRST_NAME, ' ', e.LAST_NAME) AS empName, ps.GROSS_PAY, ps.TAX_AMOUNT, ps.INSURANCE, ps.NET_PAY, ps.STATUS FROM PAYSLIPS ps JOIN EMPLOYEES e ON ps.EMP_ID = e.EMP_ID WHERE ps.PERIOD_ID = #{periodId} ORDER BY e.LAST_NAME, e.FIRST_NAME

SELECT pp.PERIOD_NAME, pp.START_DATE, pp.END_DATE, COUNT(ps.PAYSLIP_ID) AS payslipCount, SUM(ps.GROSS_PAY) AS totalGross, SUM(ps.NET_PAY) AS totalNet, SUM(ps.TAX_AMOUNT) AS totalTax FROM PAY_PERIODS pp LEFT JOIN PAYSLIPS ps ON pp.PERIOD_ID = ps.PERIOD_ID WHERE pp.PERIOD_ID = #{periodId} GROUP BY pp.PERIOD_NAME, pp.START_DATE, pp.END_DATE
mapper.update: UPDATE PAYSLIPS SET STATUS = 'APPROVED', PROCESSED_BY = #{approvedBy} WHERE PAYSLIP_ID = #{payslipId} AND STATUS = 'DRAFT'
UPDATE PAYSLIPS SET STATUS = 'APPROVED', PROCESSED_BY = #{approvedBy} WHERE PERIOD_ID = #{periodId} AND STATUS = 'DRAFT'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM PAYSLIPS WHERE PERIOD_ID = #{periodId} AND STATUS = 'DRAFT'
mapper.select: SELECT a.EMP_ID, SUM(a.AMOUNT) AS totalAllowance FROM ALLOWANCES a JOIN EMPLOYEES e ON a.EMP_ID = e.EMP_ID WHERE e.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND a.EFFECTIVE_FROM <= #{endDate} AND (a.EFFECTIVE_TO IS NULL OR a.EFFECTIVE_TO >= #{startDate}) GROUP BY a.EMP_ID
